issues.reason: Both halves hold: a comparative 'does not entail the positive' (taller-than-Y does not make X tall), and a property of a plural's members 'is never predicated of the group symbol' - (Member sk_plant_1 old) is exactly the group-as-object reading the plural rules warn against.

Sealing states that a definite NP is presupposed to exist whatever the seal says about it, so its Member typing atom goes at top level beside the wrapper 'in every sealing construct alike'; 'the efficiency' is definite.

'more power' and 'more cheaply' have no stated standard, and every licensed comparative head (More / MoreBy / TimesAs / SameDegree) requires a second argument, so leaving the unrepresentable comparative out is the prescribed handling - the reviewer's own second gap.

The appositive's anchor is an indefinite introduced inside the seal, which the projection rule explicitly keeps sealed ('its witness stays sealed'), so there is no licensed route to place the appositive at top level; nothing false is asserted, making this a scoping gap rather than a defect.

gaps_confirmed: an attitude NOUN with a that-clause complement in a specificational copular clause ('The administration's hope is that P') - the attitude section covers attitude verbs only
a bare attributive comparative with no stated standard ('older plants', 'more power', 'more cheaply') is unrepresentable

a bare plural in an oblique-object position ('the efficiency of older coal-fired plants') - the determiner rule makes a bare plural generic while the oblique-object rule lists only articles, mass nouns, domains and proper names
whether definitional decomposition atoms (a fused compound's genus) belong inside or outside a seal
new_gaps: not-at-issue appositive content inside a seal ('- the most affected segment -') has no projection route when its anchor is a sealed indefinite, so writer-asserted material stays inside the attitude's scope
repair_summary: Removed (Member sk_plant_1 old) - the comparative 'older' entails no positive and could not be predicated of the group symbol anyway, and no standard is stated for a More atom. Moved the definite 'the efficiency' typing atom (Member sk_efficiency_1 efficiency) out of the sealed Theme term to top level as eff_type.
notes: The seal itself, the (Most affected sk_plant_1 segment) superlative with its class atom, the means oblique (By sk_produce_1 sk_increase_1) and the tense-free non-finite complements are all correct or acceptable improvisation.
